prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: Garden of the wedding venue. A small, elegant present-day outdoor wedding garden on a manicured green lawn, in sunny daylight. Back side: a white wooden wedding arch at the end of the aisle, hung with sheer white drapes and garlands of white roses, peonies and greenery, with a tall clipped hedge and leafy trees behind it. A straight aisle of white petals on a pale runner runs down the middle of the lawn from the camera to the arch, between two short rows of white folding chairs that face the arch. Left side: a clipped boxwood hedge and, in front of it, a small round white high cocktail table holding a silver tray. Right side: white rose bushes along a low cream stone garden wall. Front side (behind the camera): a gravel path from the venue's terrace, the way in, where the aisle begins. Sunlight comes from high on the right and gives warm, soft highlights.

Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
